name: LeafLoop
description: Plant-as-a-service for offices in Bangalore. We deliver, maintain and swap live plants for companies of 10-200 people on a monthly subscription. 40 customers, 3 field staff, founded 2025.

documents.title: Pricing SOP
documents.content:
# Pricing SOP

- Plans: Starter (10 plants) Rs 4,000/month, Growth (25 plants) Rs 9,000/month, Custom above 25 plants.
- Discounts: maximum 15% and only for annual prepayment. Never discount the first month.
- Any custom quote above Rs 50,000/month needs founder approval.

documents.title: Customer Onboarding SOP
documents.content:
# Customer Onboarding SOP

1. Site visit within 3 working days of signup (light levels, AC, footfall).
2. Plant plan sent within 48 hours of the visit.
3. Installation on a weekday before 10am so offices aren't disrupted.
4. First maintenance visit 7 days after install, then every 2 weeks.
5. Every customer gets a WhatsApp group with their field staff member.

documents.title: Plant Replacement SOP
documents.content:
# Plant Replacement SOP

- Any plant below health score 3/5 at a maintenance visit is swapped within 5 working days at no cost.
- Quarterly swap: rotate 30% of plants every quarter to keep the space fresh.
- Removed plants go to the nursery for recovery; log every swap in the tracker sheet.

documents.title: Company facts
documents.content:
# Company facts

- Nursery partner: Green Roots, Hoskote. Supply cost averages 35% of plan price.
- Field staff cost: Rs 22,000/month each; each can handle about 15 customers.
- Churn: 4% monthly, mostly offices that moved or downsized.
- Top acquisition source so far: referrals from office managers (60% of customers).
- Tools in use: Google Sheets for tracking, WhatsApp Business for support, Razorpay for billing.
